versions.changelog:
Initial release of the search skill using Tavily's LLM-optimized search API.

- Search the web with result snippets, scores, and rich filtering options.
- Supports basic and advanced searches with customizable parameters (domain filters, depth, time range, etc).
- Provides easy CLI usage and sample curl commands.
- Includes detailed API reference and practical usage tips.
- Tavily API key configuration instructions included.
